prompts.hero_charge: Use case: illustration-story. Identity reference is the brown-haired gold-armored hero in attached images, preserve reddish-brown swept spiky hair, amber eyes, youthful masculine angular face, gold furnace-themed armor, broad flared high collar, geometric diamond chest motif, small overlapping waist plates, black trousers, gold gauntlets and gold greaves. No glossy 3D reflections. POSE: grounded low kneel before unleashing a counterattack, three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT. His right knee rests on the ground, left knee raised and left boot planted firmly. Body coils over the raised knee, shoulders counter-rotate relative to hips. His LEFT forearm carries exactly ONE large round gold shield with a central boss and engraved circular furnace ridges, the shield slants diagonally DOWN toward screen left, lower rim touches the floor; left hand visibly grips behind its rim. His RIGHT gauntleted hand is clenched close to his right hip, ready to brace and drive the body upward. Face tilted down, both eyes narrowed with focused resolve, lips firmly closed. Hair crest blown slightly backward toward screen left. Whole head, shield, both feet and hands entirely visible, no cropped limbs, ample transparent margins. No floor, no shadow outside the figure, no chain, no fire, no glow, no speed lines, no writing, no panels. This is the first key pose of an animation, not a poster. backgroundRedesign: Use case: illustration-story. Paint a NEW hand-painted 2D animation background plate, wide 16:9, NO characters. The FIRST reference demonstrates the desired animation-background drawing language: large irregular stone slabs, brush-painted shadow masses, imperfect hand-drawn architectural edges, atmospheric simplification, dark indigo spaces rather than clean 3D modular objects. Do not copy its characters or captions. The SECOND reference provides ONLY the story layout: a palace gateway up steps in the rear middle, dark stone columns at the sides, a small bronze furnace/gate mechanism on the LEFT, open foreground floor where two armored fighters stand. REDESIGN the geometry and perspective rather than repainting the rigid reference. Uneven hand-hewn columns of varied width, worn chipped edges and nonidentical capitals, broad shallow staircase whose ends and slab widths are irregular, monumental bronze gate drawn as a few bold shapes with sparse engraved motifs. Replace the tiled square grid with a small number of BIG irregular trapezoid slabs, broken and interrupted seams, softly painted worn patches; no checkerboard, no uniform repeating bricks, no evenly spaced vertical stripes. An inhabited ancient palace, weathered but not a collapsed ruin. Asymmetric composition, subtly exaggerated hand-drawn perspective that serves action clarity. Foreground floor occupies lower 35 percent and remains broadly level and unobstructed for character contact. Preserve the small LEFT furnace and the rear gate as story anchors. Rich indigo/charcoal/purple shadow color blocks with muted warm ochre rim light from the left furnace; expressive gouache strokes and lost edges, selective ink accents. Strong depth by overlap, scale and value, not photorealistic rendering. Desired result looks unmistakably like a traditional painted background from a dramatic 2D television animation, NOT a 3D render with a texture filter. No ray tracing, no PBR, no glossy reflection, no miniature diorama, no precise CAD symmetry, no text, no subtitles, no people, no magic effects. 16:9 landscape.
